sections.label: Soldier
sections.text: Large soldier. Head black, distinctly narrowed in front; antennae 17-segmented, segment 2 very short, segment 4 about twice as long as segment 2, segment 3 longer than segment 4; labrum black, with a long pointed transparent process at the tip; mandibles black, without teeth in the anterior part, the right mandible distinctly wider than the left; fontanelle indistinct, expressed only as a depression in the middle of the head; pronotum paler than the head, dark at the margins, the anterior margin notched, the sides converging posteriorly, the posterior margin slightly concave; the pronotum with a more or less pale patch in the middle, but the pale patches are not arranged in a cross as in M. gabonensis; abdominal tergites and sternites concolorous. Measurements (mm): head length 10.28, head width 5.67, antennal length 6.74, pronotum length 1.77, width 3.55, hind tibia length 5.32, left mandible length 4.14; the mesonotum proportionally wider than in M. gabonensis, the head darker. Small soldier: antennae 17-segmented, segment 3 and segment 4 equal in length; head length 5.44, head width 2.60, pronotum length 1.30, width 2.00, hind tibia length 4.49, left mandible length 2.60.

note: Adapted from the species-level description in Emerson (1928), original in English; only the soldier (large soldier and small soldier) has characters and measurements, and the original gives no description of the worker or alate; synonyms, figure numbers, localities, type specimens and nest records are not translated. The title is OCR'd as Sjdstedt and should be Sjöstedt.
